# TgMarkdownBot — Markdown → Telegram

Paste **CommonMark** or **GitHub-Flavored Markdown** and get a live Telegram preview.

Bot: [@TgramMarkdown_bot](https://t.me/TgramMarkdown_bot)

## What it does

- Bold, italic, strike, links, lists, tables, quotes
- Code blocks (fenced + unfenced detection)
- Images attached in the same reply
- Mermaid diagrams rendered as images
- HTML tags like `<b>`, `<i>`, `<code>` translated cleanly

## How to use

### Private chat

Just paste your markdown.

### Groups / channels

```
/md@TgramMarkdown_bot # Title
**hello** and `code`
```

## Try this

```md
# Hello Telegram
**Bold**, _italic_, and `inline code`

- [x] Works in groups
- [ ] Needs a card? Nope — just open the bot
```

Start here → [@TgramMarkdown_bot](https://t.me/TgramMarkdown_bot)
